# `company.landed_cost_allocations`

Landed cost allocations: a landed-cost post, or an item receipt's own shipping. Status moves posted -> voided once; nothing else changes.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this allocation. |
| `number` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | uq_landed_cost_allocations_number | — | Allocation number (LC-n), or the item receipt number for its own shipping. |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | allocation (landed-cost post) or receipt_shipping (an item receipt's own shipping). |
| `status` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | posted, or voided once its lines are reversed. |
| `date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Date the allocation is recognised, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `basis` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | quantity, value, weight, volume or amounts. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_landed_cost_allocations_transaction | transactions.id | Journal entry the allocation posted as, or the item receipt's own entry. |
| `item_receipt_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_landed_cost_allocations_receipt | item_receipts.id | Item receipt whose own shipping this spreads; null for landed-cost post. |
| `memo` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Memo as entered; null when blank. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why the allocation was made, as the caller gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this allocation was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this allocation. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this allocation. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this allocation. |
| `voided_at` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | UTC time the allocation was voided; null while posted. |
| `voided_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Company principal that voided the allocation; null while posted. |
| `voided_via` | VARCHAR(16) | yes | — | — | — | — | Interface the allocation was voided through; null while posted. |
| `void_reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why the allocation was voided; null while posted. |
